heading.en: Reading a flower like a botanist

hook.en: Compare a pea flower with a hibiscus. One can be cut into two equal halves only one way, the other in many ways. Symmetry is the first thing a botanist notices.
hook.kn: ಬಟಾಣಿ ಹೂವನ್ನೂ ದಾಸವಾಳವನ್ನೂ ಹೋಲಿಸಿ. ಒಂದನ್ನು ಒಂದೇ ರೀತಿಯಲ್ಲಿ ಎರಡು ಸಮ ಭಾಗ ಮಾಡಬಹುದು, ಇನ್ನೊಂದನ್ನು ಹಲವು ರೀತಿಯಲ್ಲಿ.

body.en: The arrangement of flowers on the floral axis is the inflorescence. In racemose inflorescences the main axis keeps growing and flowers are borne laterally in acropetal succession, older ones below and younger ones above. In cymose inflorescences the main axis ends in a flower, so its growth is limited, and the flowers open in basipetal order.
body.kn: ಪುಷ್ಪಾಕ್ಷದ ಮೇಲೆ ಹೂಗಳ ಜೋಡಣೆ ಪುಷ್ಪಮಂಜರಿ. ರೆಸಿಮೋಸ್‌ನಲ್ಲಿ ಮುಖ್ಯ ಅಕ್ಷ ಬೆಳೆಯುತ್ತಲೇ ಇರುತ್ತದೆ, ಹೂಗಳು ಅಗ್ರಾಭಿಮುಖ ಕ್ರಮದಲ್ಲಿ. ಸೈಮೋಸ್‌ನಲ್ಲಿ ಅಕ್ಷ ಹೂವಿನಲ್ಲಿ ಕೊನೆಗೊಳ್ಳುತ್ತದೆ.

title.en: Symmetry and position of the ovary

body.en: A flower is a modified shoot with four whorls on the thalamus: calyx, corolla, androecium and gynoecium. If it can be cut into two equal halves through any radial plane it is actinomorphic, as in mustard, Datura and chilli; if only through one plane, zygomorphic, as in pea, gulmohur, bean and Cassia; Canna is asymmetric. With the ovary highest the flower is hypogynous (superior ovary; mustard, China rose, brinjal); with the ovary at the same level as the other parts it is perigynous (half-inferior; plum, rose, peach); with the thalamus enclosing the ovary it is epigynous (inferior ovary; guava, cucumber, ray florets of sunflower).
body.kn: ಹೂವಿನಲ್ಲಿ ಪುಷ್ಪಪಾತ್ರೆ, ದಳಪುಂಜ, ಪುಂಕೇಸರಗುಚ್ಛ, ಸ್ತ್ರೀಕೇಸರಗುಚ್ಛ. ತ್ರಿಜ್ಯ ಸಮಮಿತಿ: ಸಾಸಿವೆ, ಮೆಣಸಿನಕಾಯಿ; ದ್ವಿಪಾರ್ಶ್ವ ಸಮಮಿತಿ: ಬಟಾಣಿ. ಅಂಡಾಶಯ ಸ್ಥಾನ: ಅಧೋಜಾಯಿ (ಸಾಸಿವೆ), ಪರಿಜಾಯಿ (ಗುಲಾಬಿ), ಊರ್ಧ್ವಜಾಯಿ (ಸೀಬೆ).

points.en: Hypogynous: mustard; perigynous: rose, plum; epigynous: guava, cucumber

body.en: Aestivation is the way sepals or petals are arranged in the bud. In valvate aestivation the margins just touch without overlapping, as in Calotropis. In twisted aestivation each margin overlaps the next one, as in China rose, lady's finger and cotton. In imbricate aestivation the margins overlap but not in any particular direction, as in Cassia and gulmohur. In vexillary aestivation of pea and bean, the largest petal, the standard, overlaps two wings, which in turn overlap the two smallest petals fused into a keel.
body.kn: ಮೊಗ್ಗಿನಲ್ಲಿ ದಳಗಳ ಜೋಡಣೆ ಮುಕುಳ ವಿನ್ಯಾಸ. ಕವಾಟಾಕಾರ: ಎಕ್ಕ; ತಿರುಚಿದ: ದಾಸವಾಳ, ಬೆಂಡೆ; ಇಂಬ್ರಿಕೇಟ್: ಕ್ಯಾಸಿಯಾ, ಗುಲ್‌ಮೊಹರ್; ವೆಕ್ಸಿಲರಿ: ಬಟಾಣಿ, ಹುರುಳಿ.

problem.en: Describe the hibiscus (China rose) flower using three terms: symmetry, position of ovary and aestivation of the corolla.

steps.en: It can be cut into equal halves along many planes: actinomorphic.
The ovary sits above the other floral parts: hypogynous, with a superior ovary.
Each petal overlaps the next in one direction: twisted aestivation.
